[XL] [Tasks] Approval for restricted users
[For Upgrade Person]
Tasks and task flows are now loaded from the current user's point of view. For a restricted user, internal approvals are hidden. The defaults already follow the current user, so calls that only display data need no change.
Changed methods:
ITaskService.GetById(..., bool skipViewerProjection = false): returns the task without internal approval flows if restricted user.
ITaskFlowService.GetById(int id, User currentUser, bool skipRestrictedViewerCheck = false): throws UnauthorizedAccessException for an internal approval flow if restricted user.
ITaskFlowService.GetByTaskId(int taskId, User currentUser, bool skipViewerProjection = false): returns the flows without internal approvals if restricted user.
